analyst.summary: Black Box is an Essar-Group-owned global ICT infrastructure and network-integration provider with genuinely strong returns on capital (ROE ~27%, ROCE ~22%). However, revenue was essentially flat over the prior three years before a modest 6% pickup in FY26, and the stock now trades at roughly 49-69 times earnings -- a valuation that requires sustained double-digit growth the company has not yet demonstrated. Working capital has also worsened. We rate this a Sell on valuation grounds relative to the still-unproven growth reacceleration.
